description: This file contains the ValidateUtil class, which provides static utility methods for validating objects within the OpenMRS application, including validation control, length checking, and error handling.

classes.name: ValidateUtil
classes.description: A utility class for validating domain objects in OpenMRS, providing static methods to perform validation, control validation behavior, and check field lengths.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates an object using registered validators, throws ValidationException if errors are found.

methods.name: validate (overload)
methods.description: Validates an object and collects errors into an Errors object.

methods.name: validateFieldLengths
methods.description: Checks if specified fields of an object adhere to maximum length constraints.

methods.name: getDisableValidation
methods.description: Returns whether validation is globally disabled.

methods.name: isValidationDisabledForThread
methods.description: Checks if validation is disabled for the current thread.

methods.name: disableValidationForThread
methods.description: Disables validation for the current thread.

methods.name: resumeValidationForThread
methods.description: Re-enables validation for the current thread.
